Create `solution.py` implementing `Lifecycle`, `Patron`, `Curator`, and `Collection`.

`Lifecycle` is an enum with members `ACTIVE = "active"` and `RETIRED = "retired"`.

`Patron(serial, first_name, last_name, birth_date)` and `Curator(serial, first_name, last_name)` are mutable classes. `serial` must be a non-empty string. Their read-only `identifier` properties are respectively `"Patron:" + serial` and `"Curator:" + serial`. Methods `update_name(first_name, last_name)` update both names. `Patron.update_birth_date(value)` updates its birth date. All names and birth dates must be non-empty strings; invalid values raise `ValueError`.

`Collection()` maintains patrons and curators separately. `add_patron`, `add_curator`, `remove_patron`, and `remove_curator` accept only the corresponding type. Adding an identifier already present in that role raises `ValueError`. Removal is by identifier and returns `True` if found or `False` otherwise. `snapshot()` returns `{"patrons": [...], "curators": [...]}` in insertion order, with deep copies of all members so later mutations in either direction cannot cross the snapshot boundary.

`Collection.update_lifecycle(status)` accepts only a `Lifecycle` member, otherwise raising `TypeError`, and returns `None`. A new collection starts as `Lifecycle.ACTIVE`.

import unittest

from solution import Lifecycle, Patron, Curator, Collection


class CollectionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lifecycle_enum_and_updates(self):
        self.assertEqual(Lifecycle.ACTIVE.value, "active")
        self.assertEqual(Lifecycle.RETIRED.value, "retired")
        collection = Collection()
        self.assertIs(collection.lifecycle, Lifecycle.ACTIVE)
        self.assertIsNone(collection.update_lifecycle(Lifecycle.RETIRED))
        self.assertIs(collection.lifecycle, Lifecycle.RETIRED)
        for invalid in ["retired", None, 1]:
            with self.subTest(invalid=invalid), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                collection.update_lifecycle(invalid)

    def test_people_identifiers_and_mutation(self):
        patron = Patron("P7", "Ada", "Lovelace", "1815-12-10")
        curator = Curator("C2", "Grace", "Hopper")
        self.assertEqual(patron.identifier, "Patron:P7")
        self.assertEqual(curator.identifier, "Curator:C2")
        with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
            patron.identifier = "other"
        patron.update_name("Augusta", "King")
        patron.update_birth_date("1815")
        curator.update_name("Rear", "Admiral")
        self.assertEqual((patron.first_name, patron.last_name, patron.birth_date),
                         ("Augusta", "King", "1815"))
        self.assertEqual((curator.first_name, curator.last_name), ("Rear", "Admiral"))

    def test_people_reject_empty_or_non_string_fields(self):
        constructors = [
            lambda: Patron("", "A", "B", "date"),
            lambda: Patron(3, "A", "B", "date"),
            lambda: Patron("p", "", "B", "date"),
            lambda: Patron("p", "A", None, "date"),
            lambda: Patron("p", "A", "B", ""),
            lambda: Curator("", "A", "B"),
            lambda: Curator("c", [], "B"),
        ]
        for constructor in constructors:
            with self.subTest(constructor=constructor), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                constructor()
        patron = Patron("p", "A", "B", "date")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            patron.update_name("Valid", "")
        self.assertEqual((patron.first_name, patron.last_name), ("A", "B"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            patron.update_birth_date(None)

    def test_add_duplicate_remove_and_role_separation(self):
        collection = Collection()
        p1 = Patron("1", "A", "P", "d")
        p1_duplicate = Patron("1", "Other", "Name", "other")
        c1 = Curator("1", "A", "C")
        self.assertIsNone(collection.add_patron(p1))
        self.assertIsNone(collection.add_curator(c1))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            collection.add_patron(p1_duplicate)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            collection.add_patron(c1)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            collection.remove_curator(p1)
        self.assertTrue(collection.remove_patron(p1_duplicate))
        self.assertFalse(collection.remove_patron(p1))
        self.assertTrue(collection.remove_curator(c1))
        self.assertFalse(collection.remove_curator(c1))

    def test_snapshot_order_and_deep_copy_boundary(self):
        collection = Collection()
        p1 = Patron("1", "First", "Patron", "d1")
        p2 = Patron("2", "Second", "Patron", "d2")
        curator = Curator("3", "Only", "Curator")
        collection.add_patron(p1)
        collection.add_patron(p2)
        collection.add_curator(curator)
        snapshot = collection.snapshot()
        self.assertEqual([p.identifier for p in snapshot["patrons"]],
                         ["Patron:1", "Patron:2"])
        self.assertEqual([c.identifier for c in snapshot["curators"]], ["Curator:3"])
        self.assertIsNot(snapshot["patrons"][0], p1)
        p1.update_name("Changed", "Original")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["patrons"][0].first_name, "First")
        snapshot["patrons"][1].update_name("Changed", "Snapshot")
        self.assertEqual(p2.first_name, "Second")
        snapshot["patrons"].clear()
        self.assertEqual(len(collection.snapshot()["patrons"]), 2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
